Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred when WebSurfer provided incorrect information about the director of the film "West Of Shanghai," mistakenly identifying Alfred Hitchcock instead of John Farrow. This initial mistake set off a chain of incorrect subsequent plans and searches, as the Planner and WebSurfer repeated searches and actions based on the erroneous information. The error was due to misinterpretation or incorrect extraction during the information retrieval process, similar to Example 3, where a focal data point was extracted incorrectly and not effectively verified by WebSurfer.
